note: The tall stone archway off the Place du Marché that opens into the Rue Commerçante, a glass-roofed covered shopping arcade (the same arch as on the square). All shops are on the ground floor and open into one another. Inside walk: R_shop_general_01 -> R_bookshop_01 -> R_boutique_02 -> R_hardware_02 -> R_boutique_01 -> R_shop_general_02 -> R_shop_general_03 -> R_hardware_01 -> R_florist -> R_bookshop_02 -> R_boutique_03 -> R_shop_general_04 (the trading hall at the end).
